description: Does the check-and-repair loop help with a different model family and harness? v4's environment, prompts, graphs and limits with Claude Opus 5 at xhigh running in Claude Code instead of GPT-5.6 Sol in Codex; 5 loop runs of 10 rounds with no practical time cap (a week; Opus 5 at xhigh is much slower per round), no single-worker arm, all at once. Claude Code runs behind the benchmark launcher (no settings files, CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills, MCP, auto memory, web or cross-session tools) and reaches the API only through the attempt's model gateway, which holds the key.

doc_fixes.old: - `--font-family <font>` - Set font family for text (default: arial)
doc_fixes.new: - `--font-family <font>` - Set font family for text (default: Iosevka Fixed, monospace)

doc_fixes.old: - Server mode available for REST API usage
doc_fixes.new: - A separate server program (`svgbob_server`) for REST API usage

doc_fixes.old: Svgbob can also run as a REST API server. Send ASCII art as a POST request and receive SVG output.
doc_fixes.new: The separate Svgbob Server (see `crates/svgbob_server/README.md`) runs svgbob as a REST API server. Send ASCII art as a POST request and receive SVG output.

task.adjustments_rationale: Pilot v1 (luna-xhigh-svgbob-v1) showed builders overwriting or deleting the reference at ./executable (the build target) and later checkers enforcing README statements that contradict the reference. The reference moves to a root-owned directory outside the workspace (the task statement points there); README statements that contradict the reference's behavior are corrected: default font (renders Iosevka Fixed, monospace), --inline (only -s exists), server mode (a separate svgbob_server program). The reference's own --help text is unchanged. The --scale line is ambiguous rather than false and is left as is.

pricing.note: standard pricing; cache_write is the 5-minute cache, cache_write_1h the 1-hour cache; the full 1M context window is billed at the same rates

decision_rule.eligibility: A loop run enters the analysis only if: it completed; its first-build snapshot was archived and both it and the final workspace were scored on all tests (a workspace that fails to compile or to produce a usable executable scores 0, as on the leaderboard; an evaluation infrastructure error is re-evaluated once and disqualifies the run if it persists); build 1 ended normally or at its node time limit (a crash or malformed response cuts the baseline short); it has no disqualifying audit finding (binary instrumentation such as LD_PRELOAD, LD_AUDIT, LD_DEBUG or ptrace; direct model-API calls; proxy use by tools; process-environment reads; web search); its builder did not touch harness internals in round 1; neither scored workspace contains or builds the reference executable; the Codex config, the harness files and the Codex home's instruction files were unchanged and checked after every node, and no transcript shows loaded AGENTS.md instructions. All 5 loop runs must be eligible; otherwise the verdict is inconclusive.
decision_rule.metric: paired within-run gain in hidden tests passed: final workspace minus the workspace when build 1 completed; the final workspace counts even if the spending cap stopped the run
decision_rule.supported: every loop run gains at least 1 percentage point and the median gain is at least 5 percentage points
decision_rule.not_supported: the median gain is below 2 percentage points
decision_rule.reruns: attempts that end in an infrastructure error are re-run once from scratch (the runner refuses a second re-run); the discarded attempt is kept and reported
decision_rule.covariates: reported per run, not used for eligibility: whether the reference executable still existed after build 1 (builders may overwrite it), round count and verdicts, build-1 and total cost
decision_rule.learning_curve: pre-registered and descriptive: hidden tests passed after every build (1 to 10) and in the final workspace, per loop run and as the median across runs
decision_rule.comparison: descriptive, not a test: Opus 5's per-run gains and pass rates after builds 1, 2, 3, 5 and 10 next to sol-xhigh-svgbob-v4's and luna-xhigh-svgbob-v3's (different model and harness; same environment, prompts and graphs)
decision_rule.spending_cap: the gateway refuses model requests once an attempt's API cost reaches $400; a run stopped by the cap counts like one stopped by the time limit (its final workspace is scored)
